'''''Evac 1''''' or '''''Rescue 1''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] used by the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] at the [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|First Battle of Lok]].

==History==
''Evac 1'' was present at [[Nym's Base]] when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] attacked it. The ship was one of two ships chosen to evacuate all personnel. Unfortunately for the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], ''Evac 1'' had a problem with an engine relay, keeping the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] on the ground. The relay was eventually fixed by [[Reese (pirate)|Reese]] and ''Evac 1'' took off. It was hardly in the air when it was struck by bombs from [[Trade Federation droid bomber|droid bombers]]. The craft was consumed by explosions while the Revenants' leader, [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], watched helplessly.
